subject.title: feat: add opt-in --send-spacing to pace delegated sends

question: Should `sync --follow` expose this new default-off pacing control once the timeout-budget defect is repaired?
rationale: The P1 repair is mechanical, but accepting a new operator-facing CLI setting and its scoped daemon-only behavior is a product-surface choice.

options.title: Accept the narrow daemon-only flag
options.body: Keep the default-off `--send-spacing` flag limited to delegated sends and land it after queue-time timeout handling is corrected.

options.title: Defer the flag
options.body: Keep the existing warning-only behavior until maintainers choose a broader send-rate policy covering direct and delegated sends.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow daemon-only flag
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off `--send-spacing` flag limited to delegated sends and land it after queue-time timeout handling is corrected.
